scope: ordinary Hilbert quantifier helpers under already admitted source collapse/HB endpoint; no source theory extension

theorem_types.existentialMonotonicity: forall (T : Sentence -> Prop) {n : Nat} (a b : Formula (n+1)), Nonempty (Derivation T (.imp a b)) -> Nonempty (Derivation T (.imp (.ex a) (.ex b)))
theorem_types.existentialIntroduction: forall (T : Sentence -> Prop) {n : Nat} (a : Formula (n+1)) (t : Term n), Nonempty (Derivation T (GorbowStandardInstances.instantiate a t)) -> Nonempty (Derivation T (.ex a))
theorem_types.existentialVacuity: forall (T : Sentence -> Prop) {n : Nat} (b : Formula n), Nonempty (Derivation T (.imp (.ex (GorbowPACore.weaken b)) b))
theorem_types.existentialElimination: forall (T : Sentence -> Prop) {n : Nat} (a : Formula (n+1)) (b : Formula n), Nonempty (Derivation T (.imp a (GorbowPACore.weaken b))) -> Nonempty (Derivation T (.imp (.ex a) b))
